description: Sets 2 to 5 programmes of the index side by side: type, country, minimum amount, physical presence, time to permanent residency and to citizenship, path to citizenship, dual citizenship, tax system of the country, visa-free destinations and the programme page in German and English, plus the date of the source and consultationNote.
